stack.text:
Stack: Vite + React + TS SPA in web/, built into the Docker image and served by FastAPI at /. Dev server uses AUDIBLE_SYNC_CORS_ORIGINS.

Auth: username and password, no sign-up. The first start creates an admin user and shows its generated password in the log. Signing in sets a session cookie, and the username and password can be changed under Your sign-in.

Themes: light and dark from one set of CSS variables, switched by data-theme on the root. Default is System (prefers-color-scheme). The choice lives in localStorage, not the settings API. The bearer token stays for scripts and the CLI.

poll.text: Live data: poll GET /api/status every 2s while a run is in flight, 30s when idle. The dashboard, the topbar sync button and the library's 'downloading' chip all read the same query.
